What HackerRank Bench sells

  • HackerRank Bench: Private, extended engineering tasks. Hand-built checks score how the agent behaves.
  • ASTRA benchmark: Extended engineering tasks in environments that can be reproduced.
  • Coding datasets: Coding examples for training models.
  • Private benchmarking: Private tests of model performance.
  • RL environments: Reinforcement learning environments (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
